propositions: Unit test test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning stubs /rest/api/2/field to omit Epic Link, causing the readiness poll to expire against the full 120-second production budget rather than failing fast.
The test sleeps ~120 real seconds performing ~120 stub reads because await_required_fields loops with FIELD_POLL_INTERVAL_S=1.0 until the 120-second deadline is reached.

Setting JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable to zero before the test makes the poll deterministic: exactly one attempt is made, then monotonic()>=deadline is true, and the loop breaks before sleep is called.

Asserting exactly one /rest/api/2/field read in the test serves as a guard against regression: reaching a real sleep requires a second loop iteration, which necessarily produces a second field read and fails the assertion.
The fix preserves the 120-second production default in FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S and does not modify production code paths in scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py or tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py.
The test execution time is reduced from ~120 seconds to under 0.005 seconds by eliminating the idle sleep budget, with no change to the existing assertion that Epic Link is required.
